title: elymus triticoides var. simplex
intro: Elymus triticoides var. simplex, commonly known as Blue Wild Rye, is a perennial grass species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Blue Wild Rye include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Blue Wild Rye include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
